newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close lower in a late selloff.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close lower in a late selloff.

text.p: March 4 - U.S. debt futures closed lower in a late selloff related to the hedging of corporate debt. Dealers were active sellers. Selling pressure started in five-yr note futures on mediocre demand for intermediate-term corporate debt, traders said. June bonds held above Monday's low of 109-24/32. June Euros tested support at 94.17. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuter.com))
